name: Zykalian Militia
headerMeta: Silver era · Ranged Infantry (special) · 175 leadership · T3 Seasonal (S: Legacy of Fire)
pitch: A ranged-exotic grenadier with elite blob performance but zero melee survivability. The unit demands constant repositioning and ability rotation to stay effective, especially post-nerf when cooldowns and reload times stretched.

doctrines.name: Mobility Doctrine V
doctrines.note: +7% movement speed, unlocks Sprint +15% for 12s {1} / 8s — unarbitrated

doctrines.name: Epic Combat Doctrine
doctrines.note: 3/6/9 hits, alternative to Scorching or Siege

battleRole.positioning: Deploy on a protected flank behind blob formations {1}. Maintain constant X-movement after each V or ability-2 cast — never stand still {1}. Reposition to keep DPS pressure up; vulnerable to fire-spec units (musket liquid fire, enemy Zykalians, fire rune interactions) {1}.
battleRole.tips: Press V to damage front-line blob (less ammo, more spread than spell 1). Press ability-2 to hit back line and apply debuff; hard-priority target if enemy has flamers or rival Zykalian units {1}. ALWAYS cycle V and ability-2 {1}; solitary spell-2 play loses 50% potential damage. Post-patch: throwing-skill cooldowns now 16s (↑ from 10s); reload time +33%; poison stack cap 8 (↓ from 20) {3, 4}. Avoid spell 1 to preserve ammo economy {1}.

cards.name: Musket Liquid Fire / Rival Fire units
cards.why: Multi-part fire interaction (musket liquid fire, enemy Zykalian grenades, fire runes) stacks uncontrollably {1}.

cards.name: Melee Divers
cards.why: Zero flank/duelling rating; must reposition constantly or die {1}.

matchups.pressure: You pressure: blob frontlines and ranged backlines via V and ability-2 rotation, applying fire DPS and poison debuff {1}.

controls.notes: Core loop is **V (grenade) → ability-2 (debuff + back-line pressure) → X-move instantly**. Post-patch, ability cooldowns stretch from 10s to 16s {3, 4}, requiring tighter sequencing. Spell 1 is a trap in normal play (ammo sink); reserve it only for overstacked poison refresh if needed. Hero pairing: any {1}.

gaps: Post-patch playbook: sources predate the 2026-06-25 nerf (cooldowns +60%, reload +33%, poison cap −60%); rotation viability and positioning urgency may shift. Doc priority flagged High.
